Design Landing page data panel of WeChat Official Accounts

WeChat Official Account

A platform for publishing content and providing services within the WeChat app.

My Role

Abstract core data from user research, focusing on potential user needs.

Background

The Landing Page has not been updated in more than 5 years.

Find Insight

Most logins last 20s~40s, then go to data tab.

Prioritize the Key Data shows in the Home page.

Explore

How do you define the Key Data?

Personal account

Behavior
  • Sharing life 1-2 times a week
  • Login and stay time are not fixed
  • Care about reading rate and user reading behavior
  • Hope articles will be promoted to more people
Pain Points
  • Comprehensive understanding of reading data
  • More recommendations and readings
Data Demands

Posts, Reads, Likes, Collects…

Team account

Behavior
  • Division of labor, clear topic selection, detailed schedule
  • Personnel specifically responsible for operations
  • Push for merchant promotion, care about reading & sharing data
  • Carefully read and reply during activities, some articles rewarded
Pain Points
  • Understand data performance of articles and accounts
  • Get more traffic and exposure
Data Demands

Fans, Shares, Rewards…

Official account

Behavior
  • Certain number of people, duty system
  • Don't care much about reading and fan data
  • Attention to public opinion orientation of promotional content
  • Mainly use editing and publishing without complex functions
Pain Points
  • Quickly understand article communication data
  • Pay attention to public feedback
Data Demands

Reads, Shares, Interactions and Comments
